label: Late in episode, rises at D1 after reaching S2 and at D2 on reaching S1.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.exp(ep_trial/6)
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * (action == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/6) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/6)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 23 is near zero early in the episode and grows roughly exponentially toward trial 99 (timing alone gives R^2 0.47). Beyond timing, the state the agent last saw drives it, with an effect that scales with that same late-episode growth: at D1 it is high when the previous trial reached S2 (highest after a1 S2 unrewarded, i.e. rare and unrewarded) and low after S1; at D2 it is higher when S1 is reached now. GO carries little. Plain additive state indicators get only about 0.11; multiplying by exp(ep_trial/6) is what matters, which puts these fits above the profile additive ceiling (0.23). The free fit adds rare/unrewarded refinements, GO and belief_lo terms (dev 0.41 vs 0.37 for the short form). Belief and the hidden good state add little. Large single-step spikes (around 0.4) after S2 are still under-predicted.
